threats.title: Unencrypted Communication
threats.description: Data flows over unencrypted channels can be intercepted and spoofed.
threats.mitigation: Use TLS 1.2+, HTTPS, or VPN for all data flows

threats.title: Missing Authentication
threats.description: External entities without authentication can spoof legitimate users or systems.
threats.mitigation: Implement mutual authentication, OAuth 2.0, or mTLS

threats.title: Weak Credential Storage
threats.description: Credentials stored without hashing or encryption can be spoofed if leaked.
threats.mitigation: Hash credentials with bcrypt/Argon2, encrypt sensitive data at rest

threats.title: Unencrypted Data in Transit
threats.description: Data transmitted over unencrypted channels can be modified in transit.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt all data in transit with TLS 1.2+, use HTTPS

threats.title: No Integrity Checking
threats.description: Without checksums or signatures, tampering cannot be detected.
threats.mitigation: Implement HMAC, digital signatures, or message authentication codes

threats.title: Unvalidated Input
threats.description: Processes without input validation can be exploited to tamper with data or logic.
threats.mitigation: Validate and sanitize all inputs, use allowlists, perform type checking

threats.title: SQL Injection Risk
threats.description: Database processes receiving SQL queries without parameterization are vulnerable.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries, prepared statements, ORM frameworks

threats.title: Missing Audit Logging
threats.description: Without audit logs, users can deny their actions.
threats.mitigation: Implement comprehensive audit logging with timestamps and user IDs

threats.title: Non-Repudiation Failure
threats.description: Without digital signatures or countersignatures, origin cannot be proven.
threats.mitigation: Use digital signatures, PKI, or blockchain-based proof of origin

threats.title: Sensitive Data Exposure in Transit
threats.description: Sensitive data (PII, credentials, keys) transmitted unencrypted can be exposed.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt all sensitive data in transit and at rest, use TLS

threats.title: Unencrypted Data at Rest
threats.description: Data stored without encryption can be accessed by unauthorized users.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt sensitive data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent

threats.title: Debug Information Exposure
threats.description: Error messages, stack traces, or debug info can leak sensitive architecture details.
threats.mitigation: Disable debug logging in production, sanitize error messages

threats.title: Insufficient Access Control
threats.description: Weak or missing access controls allow unauthorized information access.
threats.mitigation: Implement RBAC, ABAC, or policy-based access control with least privilege

threats.title: No Rate Limiting
threats.description: Services without rate limiting can be flooded with requests, causing DoS.
threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting, throttling, and request queuing

threats.title: Resource Exhaustion
threats.description: Processes with unbounded resource allocation can be exhausted.
threats.mitigation: Set memory/CPU/connection limits, use auto-scaling

threats.title: DDoS Vulnerability
threats.description: Systems exposed to internet without DDoS protection are vulnerable.
threats.mitigation: Use CDN, WAF, cloud DDoS protection (AWS Shield, Cloudflare)

threats.title: Missing Authorization Checks
threats.description: Processes without authorization checks allow privilege escalation.
threats.mitigation: Implement fine-grained authorization, check permissions on every action

threats.title: Weak Password Policy
threats.description: Weak password requirements enable brute force attacks and privilege escalation.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strong password policy, MFA, rate limit login attempts

threats.title: Insecure Deserialization
threats.description: Deserializing untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution.
threats.mitigation: Use safe deserialization methods, validate data types, avoid pickle/eval

threats.title: Overly Permissive Roles
threats.description: Users assigned overly broad roles can perform unauthorized actions.
threats.mitigation: Apply principle of least privilege, use fine-grained roles

Reproducibility.label: How easily can the threat be reproduced?

Exploitability.label: How easy is it to exploit?

Discoverability.label: How easy is it to discover?
